title: Glass Confetti
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A bright, euphoric dance-pop rush: a punchy CasioRZ1 breakbeat under a fast square-wave arp, sidechained supersaw pads that pump under the kick, and a chopped 'useme' vocal hook that stutters into the chorus. It peaks early then deconstructs into a felt-piano breakdown before a final funkier lift and a delayed, roomy outro.
